decisions.reason: The articulated dumper fits the firm's core rugged-vehicle competence and broadens its construction range at low incremental cost, so withdrawal is unlikely despite the earlier exit of the compact dumper.

The mine rescue vehicle is a niche product far from the core offer, but it suits the firm's underground expertise and the long sales cycles typical of safety equipment, so it will likely get more time.
The multi-model telescopic loader line is a substantial investment in an adjacent lifting segment and is too young to abandon.
The material lift line is close to the established offer and is the rental market's most popular lift, as the recent large order shows.
The compact mining loader shows strong field results, with 1,000 operating hours in seven months, which supports keeping it despite its distance from the core offer.
